messages:
maria: Quick sync on v2.17.0 release notes + internal announce. Canary scheduled 08:00 UTC, quiet window 07:45-09:30 UTC. Draft here: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.17.0-draft — please flag customer-facing items.

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.17.0 --targets=canary-10 --timeout=20m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.17.0 -> canary-10 (10 hosts). Monitoring: p95, p99, 5xx, mem.

anya: Note: we added a compatibility note about the async streaming API change — servers default to the new protocol; clients remain compatible. Add one-line workaround for older SDKs.

maria: done. Also added: Dedicated fleets pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-03-10 for GA; unpinning ~2 weeks post-GA on request.

ops-oncall: Rollback rules: auto-rollback if 5xx >= 0.15% sustained 5m OR p99 +35% for 10m. Manual rollback: release owner + oncall. I'll be watching 07:30-10:00 UTC (PD_Rollout).

deploybot: Canary health update @12m: p95 +4%, p99 +9%, 5xx 0.03%. No auto-rollback.

maria: Final internal announce copy (posting to #eng-releases at 07:50 UTC):
"Internal: staged rollout v2.17.0. Canary healthy; promoting to staged rollout. Quiet window 07:45-09:30 UTC. Notes: Dedicated runtime pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-03-10; async streaming API compatibility note added; rollback runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.17-rollout. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Rollout). Public announce planned 09:15 UTC."

anya: LGTM.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged, will call rollback if thresholds hit.

maria: Posting internal announce now :rocket:

deploybot: /announce internal "v2.17.0 staged rollout — canary healthy, promoting to staged" --channel=#eng-releases --when=6912347400

maria: queued. Closing thread after promote.
